Dhruv and Kavya plan a lazy Sunday but feel the pressure of missing out when they see their friends enjoying exciting activities on social media. This leads them to seek ways to spice up their day.
A morning rush to work results in a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling their moods. Throughout the day, they attempt to make amends, highlighting the irony and sweetness of their relationship.
A sleepless night due to mosquitoes leads to the discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, prompting a long conversation about their past relationships.
Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.
During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?
The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.
The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

Adhira and Shagun are in a disagreement about whom to select for a wedding film promo: a boring aunt from the bride's side or a lively drunk aunt from the groom's family. Things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.

Vishnu, the Agarwal's househelp cum man friday is desired by the sisters as an office boy to help them sort out their business affairs. The parents are naturally opposed to the idea. Thus begins another standoff in the Agarwal household - and Vishnu's position in the house is at stake. Who will finally lay claim over Vishnu's priceless services?

In a footage from a wedding they just filmed, the sisters find a drunken confession from the bride's best friend. It turns out she is the groom's ex - and he hasn't told the bride to be. Caught in the moral dilemma of choosing to tell the bride or not, the sisters find themselves on other ends of the argument. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Adhira's father might have a similar secret hidden from everyone. Will the sisters do the morally right thing or the financially right thing? And what is the father's bizarre obsession with knowing who the groom's mom is?

Chasing a competitive business pitch to work for a coveted fashion firm, the sisters are again at different sides of a dilemma. The commitment to the new opportunity would be for a minimum two years, which Adhira is reluctant to make at the age of 25. Whereas Shagun, having already quit her high paying corporate job to join this business, sees no harm in seizing the opportunity with open arms. As their argument turns to a fight, we are left wondering if this is in fact the fight to end all fights. Will the sisters come to the same page and work for the pitch? Or will Happily Hitched disband for good?
Nikhil Solanki arrives at his in-laws' home, where a series of mishaps culminate in a significant blunder that upsets his father-in-law, Prakash Sharma. Both struggle to address the situation openly.
Prakash avoids acknowledging that Nikhil damaged his car, instead blaming neighborhood children. Nikhil's attempts to rectify the situation lead to further complications.
During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.
A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.
Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.
The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

While Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) are stuck in the agonizing "waiting period" of the CARA process, the tension shifts to the two sets of parents. The episode highlights that even when everyone agrees on the goal (the grandchild), their different ways of expressing love and anxiety can lead to a hilarious yet deep-seated cultural clash.

The wait is over: Anita and Nikhil are matched with a child. However, instead of the pure euphoria they expected, they are hit with a wave of intense anxiety. The title "Are We Ready?" reflects the internal crisis the couple faces as they realize their lives are about to change irrevocably—not in nine months, but in a matter of days.

The finale begins with the arrival of the moment Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) have spent the entire season preparing for: bringing their adopted daughter home. The episode isn't just about the new arrival, but about how each family member adapts to their "What The Future" role.
Shaurya struggles with getting recognition for his efforts at work while Sanya debates shifting out of her home. Both of them help each other step out of their comfort zones and grow
As Shaurya and Sanya shift in together, Sanya takes a gamble at work which impacts both of their lives.
As Shaurya and Sanya deal with the realization of having fallen for each other, they have to prioritize what is more important - emotions or logic?

Having finally admitted their feelings to each other, Shaurya and Sanya's honeymoon weekend is over and they must get back to reality. With Shaurya up for a promotion and Sanya doubtful about her growth in this company, what is this new couple in for?

With appraisals around the corner, Shaurya and Sanya brace themselves for the unexpected. Eventually, Shaurya gets his first real lesson in team management and Sanya makes a crucial decision to help her get what she wants.

To mark 3 months of being together, Shaurya convinces Sanya to organise something for their "monthiversary." However, things begin to get complicated as Shaurya finds himself working directly with Sanya - for the first time since they started dating.

Shaurya eventually ends up at Akhil’s party but to his surprise does not feel like he belongs there. Meanwhile, Ratna invites Sanya to have a drink with her. Sanya still upset about Shaurya lying to her begins to feel better with Ratna and her friends. To her surprise Shaurya shows up there as well to save their monthi-versary. However, things seem to go in the opposite direction soon.

Shaurya’s presentation does not go as planned and he ends up overpromising samples to the client on a three day deadline. This leads to the team having to work round the clock. Meanwhile, Sanya makes a plan to take a break from work and convinces Shaurya to do go somewhere together. Both Shaurya and Sanya finally spend some quality time with each other but things take a turn when Shaurya gets a call from Vinod.

Sanya decides to move back to her room. Shaurya isn’t happy about this. To make things worse Akhil is hard on him for overpromising and almost losing the client. Akhil demands that the team fixes the situation and gets them another chance.

The episode sets the stage for the series: Ray and Nikhat are best friends and roommates who have just started their journey into independent adulthood. The central conflict is the classic "End of the Month" crisis—where your bank account is empty, but your social and survival needs are not.

The episode centers on a surprise visit from Nikhat’s mother, which triggers a high-speed cleaning operation. For any young person living away from home, the "parental visit" is a performance of maturity, and Ray and Nikhat are determined to win an Oscar for "Most Responsible Adults."

The episode explores the gap between digital perception and reality. Ray and Nikhat find themselves caught in a cycle of comparing their "boring" lives to the filtered, high-glamour lives of their peers on Instagram.

The episode follows a high-stakes day for both girls. Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) is trying to climb the corporate ladder and has a critical presentation, while Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) is dealing with the thrill and anxiety of a potential romantic connection. The title reflects the constant "hustle" and the physical and metaphorical state of being "in transit" in life.

theme.shortDescription: Light humour dramas with real taste of the real world around us!
theme.description: Light humour dramas with real taste of the real world around us!

description: Dice Media brings premium Indian web series with relatable stories of modern life—drama, rom-coms, comedy, and workplace tales featuring friendship, careers, and relationships.

title: Epic Crimes

schedules.description: A Grocery Store Assistant Develops Feelings For A College-Going Young Woman Who Frequently Visits The Shop. What Begins As A Silent Admiration Takes An Unexpected Turn When He Finally Gathers The Courage To Propose To Her.

A Yoga Professional Is Sexually Assaulted By A Man Whose House She Goes To Train. The Man Initially Acts As Someone Who Intends To Help Treat Her Ailing Father, But Ends Up Using Her For His Benefits.

Two brothers running a tailoring business secretly engage in illegal activities that exploit their customers’ trust. When one family becomes affected by their actions, they decide to fight back. Their determination helps uncover the entire racket.

A Man Falls For A Woman Who Exploits His Affection For Money, Working With An Accomplice To Rob Him. As He Loses His Savings And His Marriage Begins To Collapse, He Must Face The Consequences Of His Choices.

A Widow Is Having An Affair With Her Brother-In-Law. The Mother-In-Law Always Suspects About The Affair. She Tries To Get Her Son Married To Another Woman. This Is When Envy Takes Place And Things Go Berserk.

What appears to be an ordinary household is driven by secrets, resentment, and unspoken desires. As trust breaks down, one decision triggers an irreversible chain of events. The journey concludes with justice prevailing over deception.

A Married Woman Becomes Increasingly Frustrated By The Challenges In Her Marital Relationship. Desperate To Keep A Deeply Personal Family Secret From Becoming Public, She Begins To Manipulate A Loyal Household Employee Into Helping Her. As Pressure, Fear, And Emotional Conflict Intensify, The Lives Of Everyone Involved Are Pushed Toward A Tragic And Unforeseen Turning Point.

A newly married woman becomes involved in a secret relationship that threatens the peace of her household. As hidden truths emerge, a series of tragic events shakes the family. A determined investigation uncovers a web of deception, leading the police to the real culprits.

A Married Man Marries Another Woman Because He Is Unable To Conceive With His First Wife. He, Along With His Mother-In-Law Ill-Treat His First Wife And Keep Her Home As A Maid. The Second Wife Always Suspects Something Fishy In This House And Confronts Her Husband And Mother-In-Law.

Rajesh Suspects That His Wife, Veena, Is Being Unfaithful. After An Accident Leaves Him Believed To Be Bedridden And Unconscious, He Secretly Observes The Truth About Her Relationship With Another Man. As Veena And Her Lover Plot Against Him, Rajesh Devises A Plan To Expose Their Actions, Leading To Dramatic Consequences That Ultimately Bring Justice And A New Beginning To His Life.

Unable To Conceive, A Woman Considers Surrogacy In The Hope Of Starting A Family. But When The Surrogate Develops Feelings For Her Husband And He Reciprocates, The Arrangement Sparks Conflict And Exposes Deep Family Tensions.

Amar Lal Choudhary, Known As Daddu, Shocks His Family By Marrying A Much Younger Woman, Imarti. As Tensions Rise Within The Household, Greed, Mistrust, And Hidden Motives Lead To A Series Of Conflicts. When A Tragedy Strikes, An Innocent Family Member Is Blamed, While The True Culprit Escapes With The Family'S Wealth, Leaving The Family Shattered.
A Woman Forces Herself On Her Sister'S Husband. He Always Resists Her, But She Finds A Way Back. Eventually, The Father Of The Women Find Out

Arvind And Tina, A Married Working Couple, Struggle With A Troubled Relationship. Their Lives Are Further Disrupted When Usha Arrives, Claiming To Be Arvind'S First Wife, Forcing The Family To Accept Her Presence. As Misunderstandings And Emotional Distances Grow, Tina And Arvind Find Comfort Elsewhere, Leading To A Series Of Betrayals And Conflicts. When A Plot Against Usha Takes A Tragic Turn, Shocking Truths Come To Light, Resulting In Life-Altering Consequences For Everyone Involved.

A college student’s reckless decisions threaten to tear her family apart. As loyalties shift and tensions intensify, relationships are pushed to their limits. A desperate attempt to silence the truth leads to a gripping climax.

An NRI returns to his hometown hoping for a fresh start but finds himself trapped in a troubled marriage. Pushed to emotional extremes, he begins committing a series of crimes. His reign of terror comes to an end when survivors and police join forces.

Unable To Provide The Lifestyle His Wife Desires, A Milkman Turns To Deceit And Begins Exploiting Two Lonely Women In The Neighbourhood For Their Jewellery. His Scheme Risks Exposure When A Family Member Grows Suspicious.

After Her Husband’S Death, A Woman Is Pressured Into Marrying Her Brother-In-Law. He Soon Grows Resentful And Becomes Involved With Another Woman, Leaving His New Wife To Question His Intentions And Her Future.

A family obsessed with protecting its reputation repeatedly takes extreme measures to hide uncomfortable truths. As past crimes begin resurfacing, their secrets become increasingly difficult to contain. The arrival of the police brings long-awaited accountability.

A woman struggles in a marriage strained by distance and neglect. Seeking emotional support elsewhere, she becomes caught in a complicated network of relationships. The resulting conflict leads to a shocking crime and investigation.

A man’s addiction to gambling costs him everything he holds dear. As greed and desperation take over, relationships crumble and tensions rise. The story culminates in a deadly confrontation and a shocking revelation.

A Wife Rents Out Her Good Looking Husband To Sleep With Other Women Because Of Their Financially Backward Condition. Eventually, The Husbands Of These Women Find Out And They Beat This Husband On Rent.

A Young Man Is In Love With His Girlfriend, But His Mother Strongly Opposes Their Relationship And Refuses To Accept Their Marriage. To Avoid Family Pressure And Continue His Relationship, He Enters Into A Contractual Marriage With Another Woman. However, As The Arrangement Grows More Complicated, Unexpected Emotions, Family Conflicts, And Hidden Truths Threaten To Disrupt Everyone'S Lives.
An Overweight Man Falls In Love With A Slim And Pretty Girl. She Rejects Him. He Marries The Girl'S Elder Sister Who Is Also Overweight. He Is Secretly Still In Love With The Younger Sister.

A bright UPSC aspirant encounters obstacles from all sides while pursuing her dreams. When tragedy strikes, investigators must untangle a maze of conflicting accounts and hidden motives. Their pursuit of justice reveals the real culprit.

A talented dancer admired by her community suddenly becomes the victim of a shocking crime. As investigators sift through conflicting motives and suspects, hidden grudges emerge. The search for justice uncovers the truth behind the tragedy.

A young bride faces relentless pressure and emotional hardship from her in-laws, while her parents struggle to meet their growing demands. When a tragic incident shatters the family, hidden evidence she left behind becomes the key to uncovering the truth. As the investigation unfolds, the authorities expose those responsible and bring them to justice.

A woman dissatisfied with her routine life begins making choices that put her family at risk. As secrets multiply, suspicion grows among her loved ones. A timely police intervention prevents a devastating outcome.

A family man falls prey to an online dating scam and suddenly goes missing. His loved ones race against time to bring him home safely. With crucial leads and relentless police efforts, the mastermind behind the operation is finally exposed.

When A Private Video Of Savita Goes Viral, Her Family Is Thrown Into Turmoil. With Trust Shattered And Relationships Strained, They Must Confront The Consequences Of The Leak And The Damage It Leaves Behind.

A man invites a woman into his home under the guise of helping her, creating suspicion within his family. As hidden truths emerge, relationships begin to unravel. A shocking revelation ultimately results in tragedy.

A Young Married Woman Struggles To Find Acceptance And Respect In Her Marital Home, Where She Faces Constant Mistreatment From Her Domineering Mother-In-Law. Feeling Isolated And Emotionally Neglected, She Finds Comfort In The Attention And Support Of An Electrician Who Has Long Harbored Deep Feelings For Her. As Their Bond Grows Stronger, She Is Forced To Navigate The Difficult Choice Between Family Obligations And Her Search For Happiness And Dignity.

A local journalist becomes emotionally involved in the personal struggles of his neighbor. What begins as sympathy gradually turns into a dangerous entanglement. The situation spirals into a crime that changes many lives.

A woman hides a secret relationship behind a carefully crafted façade. As financial disputes and personal conflicts intensify, those around her become unwilling participants in the drama. The story culminates in a deadly reckoning.
A house help becomes entangled in the affairs of a powerful household. When she is found dead, suspicion falls on several people around her. Scientific evidence ultimately reveals the true offender.

Divya And Vinay Are Happily Married And Live With Vinay'S Elder Brother, Anoop. Their Lives Take An Unexpected Turn When Divya'S Widowed Mother, Sanjana, Develops A Close Bond With Anoop. As Their Relationship Grows, It Faces Strong Opposition From Family Members, Leading To Rising Tensions, Misunderstandings, And A Tragic Chain Of Events That Changes Their Lives Forever.

Two Women Employed As Domestic Helpers Join A Household, Gradually Becoming Deeply Involved In The Family'S Personal Lives. As Emotional Relationships Develop Separately With The Father And The Son, Their Presence Begins To Alter The Dynamics Within The Home, Leading To Unexpected Complications And Conflicts.
A Man Is Unable To Pay Off His Loans And So He Lets His Wife Sleep With The Loan Shark. The Wife Gets Enraged And Seeks Vengeance. Their Small Son Suffers In The Bargain.

Anand, A Divorced Father, Lives With His Daughter, Divya. When Their Neighbour Sonia Publicly Humiliates Divya Over Her Relationship With Sonia'S Brother, Anand Is Pushed To The Edge. Unable To Tolerate The Insult To His Daughter, He Takes A Drastic Step That Leads To A Tragic Outcome And A Shocking Truth.

In A Small Town In Uttar Pradesh, A Family'S Life Is Shattered When A Trusted Relative Abuses Their Hospitality And Exploits His Position Within The Household. As His Manipulation, Blackmail, And Misconduct Put Two Sisters At Risk, The Elder Daughter Finds The Courage To Confront Him. The Situation Escalates Into A Tragic Confrontation, Exposing Hidden Truths And Bringing A Devastating Chapter To An End.

An Employed Boy In A Village Starts A Cyber Fraud On The Pretext Of Helping Clients With Their Online Bank Transfers. He Even Lures Youngsters To Watch Pornographic Films. All Hell Turns Lose After His Mother, Who Is A Sarpanch Finds Out About Him.
Two Girls Run A Phone Chat Racket. They Honey-Trap Two Brothers And Blackmail Them. Their Wives Find Out About Them At The End And All Hell Breaks Lose.

A Stranger Takes Advantage Of An Elderly Woman’S Memory Problems To Pose As A Distant Relative And Gain Entry Into Her Home. His Presence Leads To A Secret Relationship With The Household’S Daughter-In-Law, Putting The Family At Risk.

A man’s growing suspicions about his wife drive him into a dangerous state of obsession. What begins as distrust soon turns into a shocking crime. As investigators piece together the clues, a disturbing truth comes to light.

A woman places her trust in a respected professional who manipulates her for selfish reasons. As lies and misunderstandings deepen, multiple lives are affected. The emotional journey ends with an unexpected act of revenge.

An overweight woman constantly faces criticism and humiliation from those closest to her. Years of emotional strain push her toward a tragic breaking point. The consequences forever alter the lives around her.

A young bride enters a marriage that gradually turns into a nightmare. Struggling against personal and family challenges, she fights to survive. A dramatic turn of events eventually brings the truth before the law.

An Unusual Set Of Circumstances Forces A Man Into Marriage With Three Sisters. As He Tries To Navigate The Complicated Arrangement, Family Expectations And Personal Choices Make His Life Increasingly Difficult.

Suspicious Of His Wife, A Man Hires A Detective To Investigate Her. Instead Of Uncovering The Truth, The Detective Becomes Entangled In The Couple’S Lives And Begins Manipulating Them Both For His Own Ends.

A young man becomes deeply attached to an older woman, creating complications for everyone involved. As misunderstandings, emotions, and personal insecurities intensify, the relationship deteriorates. A sudden act of violence changes several lives forever.
Two women compete for the affection of the same man, creating jealousy and mistrust. A tragic incident changes all their lives forever. Fate ultimately delivers an unexpected form of justice.
Two Sisters Run A Massage-Racket In The Name Of A Beauty Parlour And Provide Services To Men Who Dress Up In Burqa. One Of The Married Men Falls Prey To The Honey-Trap. The Women Use Him For Money.
A Utensil Seller Uses Superstition And Deception To Draw A Wealthy Married Man Into Her Scheme. His Growing Obsession Damages His Family Life, Eventually Driving His Wife And Child Away.

Two brothers become trapped in a web of betrayal and hidden relationships. As tensions rise, a family tragedy unfolds. The truth is uncovered when a mother makes a difficult choice in the interest of justice.

Set In Rural Rajasthan, The Story Highlights The Age-Old Tradition Of Aata-Sata (Exchange Marriage) And Its Impact On Individual Lives. When A Young Man'S Love For The Sister Of An Older Divorcee Leads To An Exchange Marriage Arrangement, His Young Sister Is Forced To Marry The Divorced Man Against Her Wishes. As Her Dreams And Aspirations Are Sacrificed For Family Obligations, She Faces The Emotional And Social Consequences Of A Custom That Prioritizes Tradition Over Personal Choice.

An Impotent Man Asks His Friend To Sleep With His Wife. At First, The Wife Is Aghast, But Later She Falls For Him And Begins To Have An Affair. The Mother-In-Law Too Catches Them Several Times.  Eventually, The Husband Is Jilted And Kills Him.

A Local Politician'S Wife Is Deprived Of Attention From Her Husband. She Falls In Love With The Driver And They Have An Affair. The Driver Gets Drunk In Love So Much So That He Wants To Take The Politician'S Place.

A woman endures years of emotional and domestic turmoil that takes a severe toll on her life. Overwhelmed by her circumstances, she makes a life-altering decision. The truth eventually surfaces during a police investigation.

theme.name: Thrills and Chills
theme.shortDescription: Get your heart racing with gripping suspense, unexpected twists, and adrenaline-pumping action!
theme.description: Get your heart racing with gripping suspense, unexpected twists, and adrenaline-pumping action!

description: Epic Crimes showcases real-life-inspired crime stories exploring mysteries, betrayals, investigations, and the consequences of crime on everyday life.

title: Eros Universe Bollywood Cinema

schedules.description: A mascot for bad luck, Aarush's life turns into comical chaos after his wife runs away on the honeymoon night.
Six couples face problems in their lives when fate forces them to move away from each other. They must overcome these issues in order to make their love triumphant.

Devdas is a tragic Hindi movie about Devdas who returns home after studying for 10 years in London. Devdas shared a special bond with Paro & wanted to marry her. But his family refuses Devdas's marriage to Paro, which shatters him and he turns to alcohol for solace.

Mehak, a talented artist, develops agoraphobia after a taxi driver assaults her. She moves to a new apartment and starts having visions, leading her to think that a malevolent force has possessed her.
At first, a couple is thrilled to participate in a game show with a huge cash prize, until they find out that the game isn't for fun, it's for survival.

Gia is an emotional romantic drama about a woman caught between two loves—Neil and Kabir. Standing at a turning point in life, she must choose between two different worlds while following her heart. The film explores love, destiny, and the life-changing choices that shape true happiness.
Daal Mein Kuch Kaala Hai is the humorous tale of a budding actress who must con a rich loser to become successful in Bollywood.
Chintu Ji is a satirical comedy movie which focuses on the rivalry between two villages Hadbahedi and Triphla.
Krishna, an orphan, lives in an orphanage. He feels unwanted as all his friends have found someone to adopt them. However, his sadness turns into happiness when Lord Krishna comes to his aid.
A group of friends, along with members of the Russian mafia, get stuck on a remote island off the coast of Goa when new drugs at a rave party are consumed by the guests, turning them into zombies.
Two friends lose their jobs as the global recession hits, but their worlds really turn hilariously upside-down when they become male escorts to make ends meet.
A pregnant woman witnesses atrocities committed on women around the country while on a run from her husband.

English Vinglish is a heart-touching Hindi family drama movie about Sashi Godbole who is an insecure & under confident middle-class housewife. Her struggle to speak & understand English is ridiculed by her own family.
A rich Gujarati businessman Praveenbhai lies about his marital status when he meets Shanaya, a beautiful Bollywood debutante.
Rajdhani Express is the story of Keshav, an errand boy for an arms trafficker who wants to escape his life of crime.
A plane is hijacked by six terrorists who demand the release of Rashid Omar, their accomplice, or else the hostages will be killed.
This is a film about two "young bachelors" and one "young at heart" bachelor. It's a humorous take on their respective love stories.
When Duke meets with an accident, he is abandoned by his lover Nalini and friends, until a young boy enters his life and brings back the hope.
Six struggling aspirants get an SMS informing them that they are now the owners of an INR 1,000-crore company. But, the company has a loan of INR 1,200 crore, which they will have to repay.
A mute, aspiring actor joins forces with a man who has a powerful voice. Together they take the film industry by storm, but will their egos get in the way?
Caught in the middle of a lethal unrequited love, a kabaddi player tries to safeguard a young woman from an unwanted marriage with a dangerous faction leader.
Rana, a noble warrior, seeks revenge against his father's killer, Rishikodagan. Meanwhile, he also upsets and attracts the ire of the enemy kingdom's ruler, Raja Mahendran.

schedules.description: Ad filmmaker Rahul takes up paying guest accommodation in a house where he meets Kim. Kim falls in love with him, but he is not interested in her because she is too young.

title: Runn Short Films

schedules.description: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.
A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.
A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

schedules.description: Two teenagers running away from their home comes across a police officer who persuades them not to go, however Eelu & Rani have something else on their mind.

A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.
A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

description: Green Gold TV India brings kids the magic of animation with action, comedy, and adventure! From Super Bheem and Mighty Raju to Krishna & Balram, Luv Kushh, and Maha Ganesha—enjoy non-stop fun and timeless stories for the whole family!

title: Epic Kids

schedules.description: Encapsulating The Beautiful, Loving And Naughty Relationship Shared By Krishna And His Elder Brother Balram. Learn About Their Everyday Adventures And More.
A Four-Year-Old Raju Receives Super Human Strength When His Then Pregnant Mother Accidentally Consumes A Compound Created By His Scientist Father.
Akki Is A Nine-Year-Old Boy Blessed With Extraordinary Karate Skills. While He Tries To Lead A Normal Life, He Ensures The Optimum Usage Of His Power For Good Deeds.

The Story Lord Ganesha Is Told In A Narrative Fashion By And Old Holy Man To A 9-Year-Old-Boy Vignesh In A Temple. As The Boy Listens To The Story, He’S Fascinated By The Legend Of Ganesha And Keeps Asking Questions, Which Lead To Different Stories.

Raju And Gopi Are Playing A Mighty Raju Computer Game Where Raju Is Losing. Meanwhile, A Foreign Scientist Has Come To Aryanagar And Seems Up To Some Mischief With Neutrino. Further, Shyamu Sees Some Mysterious People At Night And Worries When His Friend Golu Goes Missing. He Seeks Raju’S Help Who Promises To Find Golu. Raju Decides That The Gang Must Be Trained In Self-Defence And Also Installs Signals Throughout The City Where People Can Warn Him About Impending Danger. A Big Gorilla Is Running Rampant In The City And Not Just Kids, But Also Their Families Are Disappearing In Aryanagar. Mighty Raju Is Accused Of Theft And Everyone Is Worried. Will Mighty Find The People Behind All This?

schedules.programName: Roro Aur Hero Bhoot Mast Zabardast
schedules.description: When Roro Meets Hero His Life Is Sent Into A Tailspin. They Are The Craziest Combination There Can Be. Roro Is Street Smart And Mischievous Whereas Hero Is Dramatic And Chaotic. They Are Best Of Friends. Hero Tries To Make Sure That Everything Works Out In The Favor Of His Friend Roro. In Trying To Do So, Hero Generally Goes Overboard And Instead Of Solving An Issue Creates A Few More. Roro On The Other Hand Is More Measured With His Plans. This Is The Reason Why They Are The Right Combination As A Team. Hero Is The Yin To Roro'S Yang. Together They Face All The Problems And Obstacles As A Well-Oiled Machine And Manage To Come Out Of It Unscathed More Often Than Not.

Akul And Nakul Are Two Naughty Asuras Who Are Sent On Earth With A Mission To Change The Perception About Asuras Being Evil. They Do So By Putting Their Special Magical Powers To Use To Help People Solve Their Problems. They Face Challenges From Kaantasur, The King Of Bad Asuras Who Wants To Show That Auras Are Evil, But He Is Always Defeated When Going Against Akul And Nakul.

schedules.description: After the alleged suicide of her priest brother, Grace travels to the remote Scottish convent. As she explores the wild cliffs and windswept beaches nearby, she uncovers what really happened with the help of Vatican priest, not only the murder but a disturbing truth about her own past which brings long-buried trauma to the surface.

1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

A convicted serial killer on day of his scheduled execution gets a last minute court-ordered psychiatric evaluation. The killer surprises the psychiatrist with his claim that he is a demon who wants the execution to go forward and claims that before their brief tie together is over, the doctor will commit three murders by day's end

Butcher’s Crossing is an epic adventure journey of a team of buffalo hunters that follows a young Harvard drop-out into the Colorado wilderness as he joins a team lead by Miller (Academy Award© winner NICOLAS CAGE) in search of a mythic herd of buffalo in 1874. The journey puts his life and sanity at risk. The adventure will get horrific, confrontation with dark will lead to descent of madness.

During the 2021 US military withdraw from Afghanistan, a SEAL team helicopter is shot down by a group of terrorists. A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief miraculously surviving the crash, while the rest of his team killed in action must guide a child to safety through a hostile Taliban armed forces and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer.

In 1914, a young man arrives at a remote island near the Antarctic Circle to take the post of weather observer only to find himself trapped in a watchtower besieged by deadly creatures which live in hiding on the island.

A couple vacationing on a Thai island wakes with no memory and a chilling video showing one killing the other. Caught in black magic and mystery, they must uncover the truth—was she spared, or did nature demand a sacrifice?
Every 23rd spring for 23days, it gets to eat…Stranded on a lonely road, a school bus full of high school players must defend themselves from the Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror.

In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures.
A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

Jack Harris who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department.

Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs.

Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

A sex comedy centered on a serial womanizer and his jilted lover. In Los Angeles, Nikki is homeless, car-less and closing in on 30, but he's good-looking, moving from one wealthy woman of 35 or 40 to another, a kept boy-toy.

This gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb.

What makes a good boss? Charming yet manipulative, he meddles in employees’ lives and crosses every line. Javier Bardem stars in this darkly comic tale where ambition sparks chaos with unexpected consequences.

Terrorists kidnap Russian Prime Minister's 2 kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant & threaten to blow up reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in and they are world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

A Young couple thinking about buying their perfect single family starter home. They visits a real estate agency where they are received by a strange sales agent and find themselves trapped in a surreal, mysterious, maze-like nightmare.
This timeless tale was originally written in 1757. Could Beauty ever love the ghastly lord, the Beast? Only true love can break the spell.

Based on the bestseller The Room, Corner Office follows a man lost in corporate absurdity. As he climbs the ladder, he finds a secret room that “doesn’t exist,” spiraling deeper into alienation and surreal humor.

A female assassin takes on covert global missions no government will admit to. Hunted worldwide, she must use all her skills to survive and eliminate the final thread of a deadly conspiracy against her.

A group of soldiers attempting to rescue a hostage from a terrorist crash land into unfamiliar jungles which are inhabited by a group of long hidden dinosaurs. Now they must find a way out before becoming prey for prehistoric predators.

Set in a fictional present, King Lear explores what it means to be human—cruelty, love, and loss. Chaos unfolds when an aging king gives power to his corrupt daughters and rejects the only one who truly loves him.

While the group of friends explore a beautiful small island, all hell breaks loose for Jessie as the rogue shark sets its hunting grounds within the vicinity. A Father with a score to settle brings his war to their doorstep.
While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

Memories are inescapable—painful, joyful, haunting. After inventor Gordon dies mysteriously, Sam uses his Rememory machine to probe others’ memories for the truth. A gripping noir mystery thriller unfolds. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.

A team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated with supernatural powers.
Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him
The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable.

Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

A FBI secret service agent, gets caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a serial killer who knows that people will log onto an "untraceable" website where he conducts violent and painful murders LIVE on the net.
Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.
THE HURT LOCKER is an intense portrayal of elite soldiers who have one of the most dangerous jobs in the world: disarming bombs during the Iraq War.

After orchestrating a brilliant escape from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Esther travels to America by impersonating the missing daughter of a wealthy family. Yet, an unexpected twist arises that pits her against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous "child" at any cost.

In the most terrifying creature feature Hatching is a story about lovelessness that creates a monster. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, a 12 year old brings its strange egg home, she hides it and keeps it warm until it hatches. The creature that emerges becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare. What has she been hatching under everyone's noses that shocks them all?
Six girlfriends, a deep cave expedition going horribly wrong, suffocating miles under the surface of Earth, breed of predators smells their skin.

Refusing to believe her story about cave-dwelling monsters, the sole survivor of a spelunking exploration gone horribly wrong is forced to follow the authorities back into the caves where something awaits. The trapped group soon faces the hunger and savage breed of predators while trying to find a way out.

Two American F-35 Lightning II fighters enter Chinese airspace and cause havoc near the coast. Flying at supersonic speeds, the F-35s create sonic booms that damage an oil refinery and fishing boats. Box office smash hit & multiple award winner Born to Fly comes to life with special operations team headed by elite pilots who face death and challenge the limits of the sky and themselves.

schedules.description: What makes a Good Boss? Is your boss good? Manipulative? Shamelessly meddles in his employees private lives? Crosses every line imaginable. The Good Boss is a biting character study with academy award winner Javier Bardem. To win the competition, the manipulative "good boss" unknowingly starts an explosive chain reaction with wild consequences.

Based on the international best-selling novel The Room. Corner Office an absurdist tale of a man lost in his own space. Our corporate hero is trying to move up in his newly acquired job and discovers a secret room in his office building; his alienation deepens when he discovers a room he's told doesn't exist. Discover human behavior to find humor in the absurdity of everyday life.

The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable. After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

A vacationing couple on an island off the coast of Thailand with no memory of the previous night must discover the mystery behind a strange video that shows one of them killing the other. In a web of mystery, black magic, and murder they must attempt to reconstruct the night's events & discover is she to blame for not being sacrificed or was it Mother Nature?

With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.
Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

Every 23rd spring for 23days, it gets to eat…Stranded on a lonely road, a school bus full of high school players must defend themselves from the Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror - ancient beast that resurfaces on the earth every 23 years to feed.

Deep in the ice of the antarctic, a team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated, super soldiers with supernatural powers who were able to fly & destroy

A group of soldiers attempting to rescue a hostage from a terrorist crash land into unfamiliar jungles which are inhabited by a group of long hidden dinosaurs. Now they must find a way out of this isolated valley before becoming prey for prehistoric predators.

Many residents of ROOM 203 have disappeared since the murder suicide of a married couple exactly fifty years ago. Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, Female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & must work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures and mercenaries hired to finish them off. This battle's about to become primitive.

Markus goes home to his teenage daughter, Mathilde, when his wife dies in a train crash. All appears to be a tragic accident until a mathematics geek, who was also a fellow passenger on the train, and his two colleagues show up.

King Lear poses the question: What does it mean to be human? Its subtitle could be Being Human. Cruelty, barbarity, savagery, kindness, tenderness, love, in a world that gives not very much back. Set in the fictional present, an aging King invites disaster when he abdicates to his corrupt, toadying daughters, and rejects his loving and honest one.

You can’t escape them. They’re everywhere. They bring tears to our eyes. They make us laugh. They bring us pain. Gordon a visionary inventor of the Rememory machine that allows him to see memories. He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.

We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

While the group of friends explore a beautiful small island, all hell breaks loose for Jessie as the rogue shark sets its hunting grounds within the vicinity. A Father with a score to settle brings his war to their doorstep.
While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

This timeless tale was originally written in 1757. Could Beauty ever love the ghastly lord, the Beast? The year is 1810. After losing his fortune at sea, a bankrupt merchant poor father-of-six, after plucking a scented rose from the repulsive master's garden must do the impossible, permit his daughter Beauty, to take his place and pay for the parent’s sins. Only true love can break the spell.

Terrorists kidnap the Russian Prime Minister's two kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant and threaten to blow up a reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in but are no match to a Next Generation UniSol. The world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

In 1914, a young man arrives at a remote island near the Antarctic Circle to take the post of weather observer only to find himself trapped in a watchtower besieged by deadly creatures which live in hiding on the island.

description: Mahua Play is India's first dedicated Bhojpuri digital junction, offering a vast library of Bhojpuri cinema, original web series, music, and live TV channels. It focuses on family-based content designed to bridge modern digital entertainment with traditional Bhojpuri culture.

title: Epic Bhojpuri

schedules.description: The Story Is About Twin Sisters, One Of Whom Dies Due To Dowry-Related Abuse. Her Spirit Enters The Other Sister To Seek Revenge.

This Story Belongs To A Great Devotee Of Ma Durga Named Shiva. Shiva And His Wife Gauri Was Facing Bad Times But Never Loses Hope In Ma Durga. Villagers And Relatives Starts Taunting That If There Is Reverence And Faith In His Devotion, Then Mother Durga Will Manifest Itself, But He Is Just Pretending To Be In Her Name. And Then One-Day Mother In A Different Gate Up Appears In Front Of Him.

A Drama Where A Couple Defies Societal Norms And Family Opposition To Unite For Love. Facing Cultural Clashes, Emotional Turmoil, And Personal Sacrifices, Their Journey Tests The Strength Of Their Bond And The Power Of True Commitment.

Dildar Sajna” Is A 2016 Bhojpuri Romance–Action–Drama Starring Arvind Akela ‘Kallu’ And Nisha Dubey. The Film Tells The Story Of Young Love Challenged By Family Opposition And An Evil Antagonist, Culminating In A Rescue Mission That Unites Estranged Characters.
The Story Revolves Around Madhu, A Wealthy Young Woman Whose Greedy Uncles Attempt To Kill Her In Order To Seize Her Property.

This Movie Highlights Values, Respect, And Traditions, Where A Young Man Navigates Life’S Challenges Guided By His Parents’ Blessings, Facing Conflicts, Sacrifices, And Moral Tests While Striving To Uphold Family Honor And Unity.
DEVOTIONAL BAND

Dreamer Prem Meets Spirited Geet During A Music Competition. Their Blossoming Romance, Captured In Soulful Songs, Faces Family Opposition And A Vengeful Rival, Testing Whether True Love Can Out‑Sing Every Obstacle.

Hathkadi 2” Is A Bhojpuri Action–Drama Film Directed By Ravi Sinha, Starring Pramod Premi Yadav And Anjana Singh. The Movie Blends Romance, Comedy, And High-Voltage Action, Focusing On Crime, Justice, And Emotional Conflict

A Movie Filled With Humor, Rivalry, And Emotions, Exploring The Playful Yet Intense Relationship Between A Mother-In-Law, Sister-In-Law, And Daughter-In-Law, Where Misunderstandings, Love, And Household Politics Create Chaos, Bonding, And Heartfelt Moments.
The Film Blends Sports, Revenge, And Social Justice Themes, Centering On A Boxer Wronged By Powerful Enemies While Also Fighting Alongside His Mother Against The Food Adulteration Mafia.
A Bhojpuri Action-Drama About Crime, Extortion, Love, And Revenge. The Protagonist Gets Caught In A Dangerous Struggle Against Powerful Criminals, Leading To Intense Action And Personal Conflict.
A Movie That Blends Romance, Family Emotions, And Cultural Traditions, Centering On A Groom’S Journey To Win Love And Respect.

Shaadi Ke Baad” (2024) Is A Bhojpuri Family Drama Starring Kajal Yadav And Kunal Tiwari. The Film Explores How A Seemingly Happy Family Is Torn Apart After Marriage Due To Conflicts Between A Conservative Mother-In-Law And A Modern Daughter-In-Law, Ultimately Questioning Whether Reconciliation Is Possible.
SAAS BINA CHAIN KAHA RE
Two Medical Students Fall In Love, But Their Journey Is Tested By Family Pressures, Societal Expectations, And Personal Ambition
DEVOTIONAL BAND
A Moneyminded Mother Favours Her Biological Son And Despises Her Adopted Son. An Argument Between The Brothers Worsens The Matter.
Movie Blends Youthful Romance With Family Melodrama, Exploring Love, Loyalty, And The Challenges Of Tradition.

Murari, Who Is Abandoned By His Parents After Being Mistaken As A Murderer, Struggles And Becomes A Successful Businessman. To Win Back His Parents’ Love, He Pretends To Be Mentally Challenged And Goes To Them. Farishta Follows His Emotional Journey Toward Dignity, Love, And Redemption.

Dahej Danav” (2019) Is A Bhojpuri Social Drama Directed By Rajesh Kumar That Tackles The Evils Of The Dowry System, Portraying How Greed And Exploitation Destroy Families And Relationships. The Film Stars Akhilesh Kumar, Kalpana Shah, And Jitendra Vats In Lead Roles
The Story Of Heera, A Fun-Loving Man Who Dreams Of Becoming A Doctor, Facing Societal Hurdles And Personal Challenges While Proving That True Healing Lies In Humanity.
A Common Man’S Fight Against Injustice And Political Corruption, As He Rises From Betrayal And Oppression To Reclaim Dignity, Voice, And Justice For His People
The Film Explores Themes Of Love, Sacrifice, And Unity Within A Joint Family, Focusing On The Eldest Daughter‑In‑Law’S Role In Maintaining Harmony Despite Personal Struggles.

schedules.programName: Kyun Ki Har Ek Saas Zaroori Hoti Hai
schedules.description: Mausam Is Married Into A Household Where Her Sassu Mas Dhaneshwari Is Ignited By Her Two Female Friends On Keeping Control Over Bahu. Mausam Is An Educated Girl But This Goes Against Her As Dhaneshwari Feels Insecure. Mausam’S Only Source Of Comfort Is Daadi Saas Photo In The House Where She Pours Her Grief Out. One Day When The Problems Reach Their Peak Mausam Wishes If Daadi Saas Was There To Guide Her. Now The Tables Turn As Daadi Saas Ensures That Dhaneshwari Is Taught How To Be A Good Saas. At Every Occasion Daadi Saas Take Possession Of Mausam'S Body And Teaches Dhaneshwari And Her Two Friends Lessons In Correcting Their Attitude And Behaviour. Daadi Saas Soul Leaves For Heavenly Abode Having Completed Her Saas Dharma And Everyone Lives Happily Ever After.

“Dulha Chor” Is A Bhojpuri Drama-Comedy About A Young Man Who Is Mistakenly Called A “Groom Thief” After Getting Caught In A Confusing Wedding Situation. As Secrets, Greed, And Misunderstandings Unfold, He Strives To Reveal The Truth, Protect Family Honor, And Win Love In The End
